items.quote: Please pay the balance within 14 days of the statement date.
items.computation: Document date (statement date) is Fri 20 Nov 2026. Period runs under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB: the day of the event (20 Nov) is not counted, counting starts 21 Nov. 14 days later (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) falls on Fri 4 Dec 2026. That day is a working day (not Sat/Sun/holiday in NW), so § 193 BGB causes no shift. Due date = 2026-12-04.
